recent_articles.title: Congress slams Centre over rising fuel prices, questions PM for not disclosing seriousness of crisis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders criticized the **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** government for its handling of rising fuel prices, accusing it of "looting" consumers with high taxes and failing to pass on benefits during periods of low global crude prices.  **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge accused the government of timing fuel price reductions around elections and resuming hikes after polling concluded. **Rajeev Gowda**, a Congress research department chairman, argued that rising fuel prices and the depreciating rupee reflected broader economic distress and called for greater transparency from the government regarding its energy policies.

recent_articles.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai booked over ‘objectionable’ comment on PM Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, **Uttar Pradesh Congress president**, is facing an FIR after a complaint from **Neeraj Kumar Rawat**, a BJP district working committee member, alleging abusive remarks against **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.  The complaint claims that Mr. Rai obstructed government work and blocked a public road with his convoy of vehicles and supporters. The police registered the case based on a video circulating online showing Mr. Rai making objectionable statements. Mr. Rai denies the allegations, calling it a tactic to silence him and accusing the BJP government of using state apparatus against opponents.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a powerful storm that killed at least 111 people in Uttar Pradesh, the **Uttar Pradesh** government directed Ministers to assess the situation and provide financial assistance. The **Congress** party criticized the **Union Government's** lack of response, highlighting the condolences from Russian President Vladimir Putin as evidence of their insensitivity.  The **Uttar Pradesh** Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a ₹4 lakh compensation for families who lost loved ones and directed officials to ensure relief for farmers and livestock owners.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Jockeying for the KPCC president’s post gains momentum, even as uncertainty looms over the party’s Chief Minister choice - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunny Joseph**, the current **KPCC** president, is expected to relinquish his position to join the upcoming UDF government.  Several prominent figures, including **Benny Behanan**, **Kodikunnil Suresh**, **Anto Antony**, and **Shafi Parambil**, are vying for the vacant post of **KPCC** president.  The **AICC** will likely choose a leader based on age, demographics, and political merit. The **INTUC** has also entered the fray, with its leader objecting to **K.C. Venugopal's** candidacy for Chief Minister.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Government formation LIVE: Impasse over chief ministerial candidate in Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leadership held marathon discussions in **New Delhi** with the three main contenders for Kerala's Chief Minister position, **K.C. Venugopal**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **V.D. Satheesan**, and **KPCC president Sunny Joseph**.  The consultations, attended by observers **Ajay Maken** and **Mukul Wasnik**, have failed to reach a decision on the selection of a new Chief Minister despite discussions lasting over three hours.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka is No 1 in revenue, panchayat services, claims Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Karnataka's** **Revenue Department** has launched a large-scale distribution drive for revenue department benefits, marking a significant achievement in delivering services to citizens.  The initiative aims to provide easier access to revenue services and empower economically weaker sections with ownership records.  **Deputy Commissioner B. Fouzia Taranum** and the entire revenue administration have played a crucial role in achieving this record level of service delivery. **Priyank Kharge**, **Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister**, highlighted the importance of land rights for accessing financial assistance like loans, crop insurance, and government subsidies.

recent_articles.title: Gram panchayat elections in Karnataka will be held before end of 2026, says Minister Priyank Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyank Kharge**, **Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Minister**, announced that the state government will hold gram panchayat elections before the end of the year.  He also stated that drinking water scarcity in Kalaburagi district is being addressed with funds from the state government, the Kalyana Karnataka Region Development Board, and recommendations from task forces headed by MLAs. **Mr. Kharge** added that a decision on expanding the State Cabinet will be made at the appropriate time by **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** and the party high command.

recent_articles.title: Three-hour meeting fails to end impasse over Congress Chief Minister for Kerala - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite consultations between **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge, Leader of the Opposition Rahul Gandhi, and AICC general secretary (organisation) K.C. Venugopal, senior leaders Ramesh Chennithala and V.D. Satheesan, and KPCC president Sunny Joseph, a decision on naming a Chief Minister for **Kerala** remains stalled.  The high command has until May 23 to finalize the candidate after considering claims from each faction, including those of Congress MLA-designates and constituents of the United Democratic Front (UDF). The consultations were marked by intense posturing and competing claims, with party workers removing aggressive flex boards and appeals made to maintain decorum.

recent_articles.title: Parties are equal partners in INDIA alliance, says U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, Uttar Pradesh Congress president, stated that the **INDIA** alliance in Uttar Pradesh is based on equal partnership and a united effort to defeat the **BJP**. He emphasized that decisions regarding the Congress's participation will be made by the high command and that the party is focusing on strengthening its organization at the booth level for the upcoming Assembly elections.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM debate: Kharge to hold crucial talks with senior leaders today evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **AICC president**, will meet with key figures in the Kerala Congress leadership, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, and **Ramesh Chennithala**, on Saturday (May 9, 2026) to discuss the selection of a new Chief Minister.  **Rahul Gandhi** is expected to meet with the Kerala leaders after a consensus emerges from the meeting chaired by **Kharge**.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams Modi Government over women’s safety citing NCRB data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party leaders, including **Mallikarjun Kharge**, criticized the **Narendra Modi Government** for its handling of women's safety and rising crime rates.  Kharge cited data from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) showing a significant increase in crimes against women, children, Dalits, Adivasis, and cybercrime during the past decade. He accused the government of using "Beti Bachao" and "Nari Vandan" as mere slogans while failing to address these issues effectively. **Alka Lamba**, president of the All India Mahila Congress, echoed these concerns, alleging that the BJP was shielding perpetrators instead of ensuring justice for victims.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Varsha Gaikwad writes to Maharashtra Governor, seeks immediate enactment of Shakti Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Varsha Gaikwad**, **Mumbai Congress president** and MP, has written to **Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma** urging urgent action on rising crimes against women in the state.  Gaikwad requested the Governor's intervention regarding the **Shakti Criminal Laws (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill, 2020**, which awaits presidential assent, and urged the government to take strict action against atrocities against women. The letter comes amid protests following a four-year-old girl's alleged rape and murder in Pune district.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka’s deep tech programme ELEVATE NxT draws strong response from startups across India - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The first cohort of **ELEVATE NxT**, a national grant-in-aid program for deep tech startups by the **Department of Electronics, IT, and Bt in Karnataka**, has received applications from across India.  Of the 983 total applications, 213 are from outside Karnataka, representing nearly 23% of the total. The selected candidates will pitch to a jury on May 6, 2026, with the final cohort selection following a three-week process. **Priyank Kharge**, IT-Bt Minister of Karnataka, announced this program in January 2026 as part of the state's "Deep Tech Decade" initiative.

recent_articles.title: Assam poll verdict rejection of blue blood politics: Himanta Biswa Sarma - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the **Chief Minister of Assam**, attributed the **BJP's** victory in the state elections to a rejection of "blue blood" politics, claiming that voters favored the party over candidates whose fathers held previous political positions.  The BJP secured 102 seats out of 126, while several Congress candidates, including Gaurav Gogoi, Debabrata Saikia, and Diganta Barman, lost their respective constituencies. Seven women were elected to the Assam Assembly, with a success rate of 11.86%.

recent_articles.title: Independent journalism punished, compliance rewarded under current regime, says Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** criticized the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** government for its alleged attempts to suppress press freedom in India.  He stated that since 2014, India's position in the World Press Freedom Index has declined and the BJP is seeking to tighten its control over social media to silence dissent. **Kharge** also accused the government of weaponizing legal frameworks to intimidate journalists and noted a sharp rise in arrests and imprisonments of journalists. He highlighted several high-profile cases, including those of journalists murdered while reporting on corruption.  He urged for upholding democratic norms by those in power.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka leadership talks in Delhi unlikely in next few weeks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders are planning to meet with **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the party president, in Delhi next week to discuss Cabinet expansion. However, the leadership issue in Karnataka is unlikely to be resolved soon due to upcoming Rajya Sabha elections and a lack of timeline from **Kharge**.  With several seats falling vacant in the Legislative Council, the party is prioritizing these elections before discussing leadership changes.

recent_articles.title: Rayaraddi urges for Mallikarjun Kharge as Karnataka Chief Minister if Siddaramaiah is to be replaced - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Basavaraj Rayaraddi**, Chief Minister Siddaramaiah's economic adviser, stated that there is no need to change the Chief Minister and suggested **Mallikarjun Kharge**, AICC president, as a potential alternative if the party decides on a leadership change.  Rayaraddi met with **Kharge** last week and urged him to resolve the ongoing confusion surrounding the leadership in Karnataka.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Cong. to hit streets to highlight demands of farmers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** will hold a protest march in Buldhana district of Maharashtra on Monday against **BJP** policies they say are harming farmers. The party, citing high farmer suicide rates in the state, demands loan waivers, land record clearing, MSP guarantees, fixed crop prices, and other agricultural reforms.  The protest is led by **Harshwardhan Sapkal**, the state Congress president.

recent_articles.title: Bail order reminder that personal liberty can’t be sacrificed for political vendetta: Pawan Khera - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pawan Khera**, a Congress leader, was granted anticipatory bail by the **Supreme Court** after allegations were made against him regarding his comments on Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma's** wife. The court found that the matter appeared to stem from political rivalry and granted pre-arrest bail with certain conditions.  **Abhishek Singhvi**, along with other legal representatives, defended Khera's liberty amidst threats and intimidation. The Congress hailed the decision as a victory for the rule of law, urging **Sarma** to reconsider his language and apologize.

recent_articles.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai hospitalised after fainting, stable - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, president of the **Uttar Pradesh Congress**, was hospitalized in Lucknow on Saturday, May 2nd, 2026. He has since been discharged and expressed gratitude for well-wishes, stating he plans to return to public service soon with renewed energy.

recent_articles.title: No date fixed to discuss leadership change in Karnataka, says Congress president Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **Congress** and Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, clarified that no decision has been made regarding a change of Chief Minister in Karnataka. He urged against speculation and "misreporting" of his comments, stating that discussions on leadership changes would be held collectively by the party leadership at an appropriate time.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Legislative Council elections to be unopposed as Congress backtracks, Shinde fields two candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has withdrawn its decision to field a candidate for the nine Legislative Council seats in Maharashtra, supporting **Ambadas Danve** from **Shiv Sena UBT** after marathon meetings and phone calls between top leaders.  The decision was announced by **Maharashtra Congress president Harshawardhan Sapkal**, who also spoke alongside leaders of the Maha Vikas Aghadi. After a day of speculation, nine candidates filed their nominations for the seats, with each party securing its allotted quota.

recent_articles.title: BJP stages protest against Kharge’s remarks on Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP Yuva Morcha** members in Kalaburagi protested against **AICC president Mallikarjun Kharge's** remarks calling **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** a "terrorist." The protesters demanded an apology from **Mr. Kharge**, criticizing his derogatory statement and the Congress' opposition to the Women's Reservation Bill (Nari Shakti Bill).  The protest march, led by **Virendra Patil Raikod**, included several prominent BJP leaders including **Basavaraj Mattimod** and **Rajkumar Patil Telkur**.

recent_articles.title: Congress questions EC notice to Kharge, alleges ulterior motives - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** officials have written to the **Election Commission of India**, questioning the issuance of a show-cause notice to party president **Mallikarjun Kharge**. They allege ulterior motives and a casual, routine manner in the notice's issuance. The letter, addressed to Chief Election Commissioner **Gyanesh Kumar** and two other commissioners, also notes that two notices with the same reference number and date were issued but signed by different officials, leaving ambiguity about their status.

recent_articles.title: Assembly Elections 2026 LIVE: EVMs reach polling centres as 5.73 crore voters set to decide fate of 4,023 candidates in Tamil Nadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, clarified his remarks about **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, stating he did not call him a terrorist but spoke about the victimisation of political opponents by the government.  He alleged that the Prime Minister is terrorizing politicians and candidates through raids conducted by the ED, Income Tax department, and CBI. **Mamata Banerjee**, West Bengal Chief Minister, criticized the Election Commission of India for denying her permission for a public meeting while prioritizing the meeting of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**. Campaigning concluded for the first phase of the assembly election in West Bengal on Tuesday with political parties engaging in sharp exchanges between the ruling Trinamool Congress and the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Poll bugle to fall silent across Tamil Nadu on Tuesday evening - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Political parties** in Tamil Nadu are concluding their intense campaigning ahead of the Assembly election on April 23rd.  Polling will begin at 7 a.m. that day, with all political functionaries and party workers not eligible to vote required to vacate the area by 6 p.m. on Tuesday. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and other prominent leaders from various parties have campaigned in the state, while the Chief Electoral Officer has outlined strict regulations for the period leading up to the election.  These include restrictions on public gatherings, vehicle usage, and the establishment of polling booths.

recent_articles.title: Kharge asks if Modi wants to be CM of West Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for his extensive campaigning in West Bengal ahead of the Assembly elections.  Kharge questioned Modi's intentions, asking whether he wanted to become the state's chief minister or remain Prime Minister. He also accused Modi of neglecting his official duties and claimed that the opposition was only against delimitation, not the women's reservation bill. **Md. Azharuddin**, Congress Minister in Telangana, joined Kharge in campaigning, highlighting a lack of development in West Bengal and emphasizing the need for Congress to bring progress.  The Assembly elections will be held in two phases on April 23 and 29 with results announced on May 4.

recent_articles.title: Women’s reservation was Modi’s ruse to bring in delimitation to defeat DMK: Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** accused **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** of using the Women’s Reservation Bill as a tactic to defeat the DMK in Tamil Nadu.  He stated that the bill was passed jointly by all parties in 2023 and criticized Modi for not implementing it despite having the power to do so. Kharge also claimed that the Delimitation Bill was unrelated to women's reservation and accused Modi of following Manusmriti, which denies power to Shudras and women.  He emphasized that the opposition alliance is for democracy, justice, and equality.

recent_articles.title: Haryana Congress announces candidates, BJP holds back-to-back meetings - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has named its mayoral candidates for all three municipal corporations in the state, while **BJP** is actively shaping its strategy and candidate selection.  The party has established a manifesto panel and held back-to-back meetings to finalize its approach. Nominations for seven municipal bodies open in two days.

recent_articles.title: Why was 2023 women’s reservation law kept in cold storage, asks Opposition after PM’s address - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Opposition leaders**, including **Mallikarjun Kharge** (Congress president) and **Ashok Gehlot** (former Rajasthan Chief Minister), sharply criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi's address to the nation, accusing him of violating the Model Code of Conduct by using official machinery to attack political opponents.  They argued that the speech was partisan and aimed at discrediting the opposition ahead of upcoming Assembly elections in Tamil Nadu and West Bengal. **John Brittas** (CPI(M) leader) demanded an apology from the Prime Minister for delaying the implementation of the women's reservation law, while **Jairam Ramesh** (Congress general secretary) called it a "partisan and polemical attack" and accused Modi of trying to manipulate the electoral map in his favor.

recent_articles.title: Parliament special sitting LIVE: Opposition hails Constitution Amendment Bill's defeat in Lok Sabha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Opposition** defeated the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026, which aimed to redistribute Lok Sabha seats based on the 2011 Census for women's reservation. The bill failed to secure a two-thirds majority in the House, leading to its withdrawal along with related legislation. **Congress** President Mallikarjun Kharge expressed gratitude for the opposition's efforts in safeguarding democracy and federalism.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: United Opposition defeated bid to harm Constitution: Kharge - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge** and other opposition leaders celebrated the defeat of a bill seeking to redraw India's political map based on the 2011 Census. **Kharge** thanked opposition parties for their united effort, while **K.C. Venugopal**, another Congress leader, expressed willingness to support the government if it implements women's reservation immediately.  **D. Raja**, CPI general secretary, and **John Brittas**, a CPI(M) MP, criticized the bill as a ploy by the Modi government to manipulate elections for political gain.

recent_articles.title: Harivansh elected Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha unopposed - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Harivansh**, a nominated member of the **Rajya Sabha**, was elected unopposed as Deputy Chairman on Friday, April 17, 2026.  President Droupadi Murmu had nominated him to fill the vacancy created by the retirement of former Chief Justice of India Ranjan Gogoi. The election followed a special sitting of Parliament and consultations with opposition leaders. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge** congratulated **Harivansh**, highlighting his experience and contributions to the Rajya Sabha.
